name: Ōki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōki town emblem in red and green: a red ring open at the top enclosing a green stylised arrow.
history: Municipal flag of Ōki, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ōki town emblem — a red ring open at the top enclosing a green stylised arrow
